verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints חוק הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל), התשס״ה–2005; metadata box gives ס״ח תשס״ה, 889 and Knesset lawitemid 2000505. The amendment list runs to תשפ״ו, 912 (2026), and the page also notes an updating notice for indexed amounts at י״פ תשפ״ה, 9555, so the consolidation is current to the 5786 year.
notes: This is the operative statute for the second (occupational/private) pension pillar: pension funds, provident funds and managing companies, licensing, and the Commissioner of Capital Markets, Insurance and Savings. It pairs with the Supervision of Financial Services (Insurance) Law and the Supervision of Financial Services (Pension Advice, Pension Marketing and Clearing System) Law, 5765-2005, which were enacted alongside it - the pillar is split across that trio, and only the Provident Funds Law is indexed here. Mandatory occupational pension coverage itself is imposed not by statute but by a general extension order (צו הרחבה) under the Collective Agreements Law; that is a labour-law instrument, flagged here because a reader will expect to find compulsory pension in the statute and will not.
